payload.text: ST0086 WP-04 Part B, the page face of AC-04.6 (vc's orders at 10:40Z and 11:08Z, vc's word): refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (patch-id 8126a568631b) over cc's B1 v2 + B2 v2 (refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-status-v2 and wp04b-wait-v2, tree 2f7cef001a4d), READY to vc at 2026-10-26 11:13Z by date -u, confirmed by vc at 11:14Z (vc's word) with tools v3 audited.
